input.quote: (j) This Agreement constitutes the entire Agreement between the parties with respect to its subject matter, and this Agreement supersedes all prior understandings, representations, negotiations and communications between the parties, oral and written.
input.rationale: A search of the whole Agreement returns no reference to insurance, and neither General Matters (clauses (a)-(j)) nor the intellectual property indemnity section contains any coverage or certificate undertaking. Garman performs delivery, installation, data conversion, training and on-site maintenance touching Sparkling's data, so the playbook expects standard vendor coverage; total absence is walk-away territory. We inserted the model clause at the preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation, certificates on request) as a new General Matters sub-clause, noting the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback in the comment.

ops.text: (k) Garman shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 where Garman processes Sparkling data; and workers' compensation insurance as required by law. Garman shall provide certificates of insurance to Sparkling on request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a standard insurance undertaking, as the Agreement currently contains none even though Garman personnel perform installation, data conversion and support involving our data and premises. These are our standard limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M); we can discuss E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M if Garman's current program is lower.
proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance clause in General Matters
